title: No usable music dataset
finding: The only song file is an unused, United-States-centred archive. It cannot support Czech or Ukrainian cohort claims and is not an active public runtime source.

evidence.detail: Archive-only song records are not suitable for the product's Czech and Ukrainian cohorts.
No active public runtime music dataset is registered.

proposedAction: Treat community memories only as research questions; if the owner commissions a music dataset, verify Czech and Ukrainian era coverage before product adoption.
